pages.text: $(t1)Tier 1$() engineering is built on $(bold)Create$(). The first payoff is $(bold)ore doubling$(): a pair of $(bold)Crushing Wheels$() turns one ore into twice the ingot.$(br2)Set up rotational power (water wheel or hand crank), build a Mechanical Press for plates, and a Crushing Wheel pair for the 2x step.

pages.title: Banking T1 tokens
pages.text: Brass is the Tier 1 ceiling material and a bread-and-butter submission. Machine blocks mint the most: a $(bold)Crushing Wheel$() banks $(t1)25$() tokens, a $(bold)Mechanical Press$() $(t1)20$() (cap 2 each).$(br2)Bank $(t1)500$() total to ascend to $(t2)Tier 2$(). See the full Create writeup in $(l:icraft:mods_t1/create)Create$(/l).
